title.es: Caza estelar ARC-170 de la República

generated.description: A blocky replica of the ARC-170 Republic starfighter from Star Wars, built mostly from quartz slabs, quartz blocks and stairs with stone and brick accents, plus a few iron bars and glass panes. It is 37 wide, 9 high and 49 deep, with a long swept-wing body and a pointed nose. The source has no description and no interior, and the block list does not show any hidden rooms.
